name: Are there specific maintenance requirements for fiber cement siding?

mainEntity.name: Are there specific maintenance requirements for fiber cement siding?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fiber cement siding is known for its low maintenance. It typically requires periodic cleaning, usually once a year, with a soft brush and mild detergent to remove dirt, mildew, or algae. Inspecting the caulk and paint every few years and making any necessary touch-ups will also help maintain its appearance and protective qualities. Avoiding high-pressure washing that could damage the finish is also important for longevity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintenance includes annual cleaning with mild detergent and periodic inspection of caulk and paint, avoiding high-pressure washing.
